entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: H-Hey, so uh... this shit here's that door[n]to the depths, right?
entries.uk: Г-гей, то, е... оце ж і є двері[n]до глибин, так?

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: It should be. Why, what's wrong?
entries.uk: Мають бути. А що, щось не так?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I dunno, it looks just like all the[n]other ones... I was thinkin' it's a[n]little disappointin'...
entries.uk: Не знаю, вони такі самі, як усі[n]інші... Я думав, трохи[n]розчаровує...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Maybe we worked too hard to get down[n]here or something.
entries.uk: Може, ми надто старалися, щоб[n]сюди спуститися, абощо.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: The lack of unforeseen circumstances[n]is nothing to complain about. Let us[n]continue.
It doesn't look like[n]it's going to open...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Guess people don't accept us enough[n]for this door to open.
entries.uk: Мабуть, люди визнають нас замало,[n]щоб ці двері відчинилися.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Th-There's nothing we can do right now.[n]This is as far as we can go.
entries.uk: З-зараз ми нічого не вдієм.[n]Далі нам не пройти.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So, should we turn back, Joker?
